content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Filtering with select, reject, and filter_map helps you reason about keeping matching elements. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Keeping matching elements. Then connect it to Excluding matching elements. The remaining syllabus points—Filtering while transforming—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.
